title: Trivialized Momentum Facilitates Diffusion Generative Modeling on Lie Groups
tldr_zh: 李群上用平凡化动量把 score 学习搬到固定李代数，首次生成高维 SO(n)/U(n) 数据
tldr_en: Trivialized momentum moves score learning to a fixed Lie algebra, enabling first high-dim SO(n)/U(n) generation

key_numbers.context: TDM test NLL on General protein dataset (2D), vs RDM 1.04, RFM 1.01
TDM test NLL on RNA dataset (7D), vs RDM −3.70, RFM −5.20
TDM log likelihood on SO(3) with 32 mixture components, vs RSGM 0.20 ± 0.03
First reported SO(n) generation beyond n=3 (SO(4), SO(6), SO(8))
Largest U(n) dimension tested (quantum oscillator and 3-qubit TFIM)
Train/test split ratio for all datasets
